0022600197.text: The Lakers (8-2, 1st in the Pacific and 1st in the West) are on a four-game winning streak and head to Detroit for their 11th game of the season, with a 3-1 road record. The Pistons (6-2, 1st in the Central, 3rd in the East) come in on a one-game losing streak, and Los Angeles is without Luka Doncic, who is day-to-day with a back injury and a game-time decision, while Detroit is missing Isaiah Joe (out, hip bruise) and Jalen Duren (out, hamstring strain), with Elijah Harkless and Isaac Jones also day-to-day and game-time decisions for reasons unrelated to injury. The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, and in 2025-26 the Lakers lost 0-2, including a 113-110 loss in Detroit on March 23, 2026.
